note.summary: This chunk lists categories of employee payments and benefits that are exempt from tax, including group company travel, strike-disruption travel, disabled travel assistance, retraining costs, employer-funded training, long service awards, suggestion scheme awards, goodwill entertainment, parking, small third-party gifts, trivial benefits, late-night/disrupted car-share travel, and work buses/subsidies. Each exemption is subject to specific conditions and, in several cases, monetary caps. These are benefit-in-kind exemptions relevant to calculating taxable employment income rather than Self Assessment process rules directly.

note.summary: HS207 lists benefits and expenses employees do not need to report on the Employment pages of a Self Assessment return because they are covered by statutory exemptions, Extra-Statutory Concessions, or PAYE Settlement Agreements. It gives brief details of common exemptions covering accommodation, meals, pensions, medical treatment abroad, medical treatment to aid return to work, health screening, nurseries and childcare vouchers/directly contracted childcare, certain living accommodation, homeworking payments, incidental overnight expenses, and directors' travel expenses. Where amounts exceed specified thresholds (e.g. childcare vouchers, incidental overnight expenses), the excess is taxable and must be entered on the return.
